prompt: I live in a US state that was admitted to the union in January 1959. What was the approximate population of the capital of my state according to the last census of the 20th century?
answer: You live in **Alaska**, admitted to the Union on **January 3, 1959**. Its capital is **Juneau**, which had an approximate population of **30,700 people** in the **2000 census**, the last census of the 20th century.
